function.description: Propose a money action to the OWNER as a card. Nothing moves: the owner taps 'Get a quote', sees the real simulated price and caps, and only then can Confirm. Use it instead of describing a command for the owner to type, and when the owner only ASKS about a money move (execute one only on an imperative line). Verbs: /send /swap /bridge /pay /claim /launch /deploy /nft /identity /writeoff /unquarantine /wallet (trust|untrust), and /restart or /update (your own background service: it finishes its work, restarts and reports back).
function.name: propose_action

also_owed.description: true only when an open /send card already pays this address AND both payments are owed (e.g. two different bounty rounds).

command.description: The owner money verb and its arguments, WITHOUT `go`, exactly as the owner would type it, e.g. `/send 0.5 native to 0xAbc… on base`, `/swap 0.1 native to 0xToken… on base`, `/bridge solana base 0.9`, `/pay https://api.x/y 0.10`, `/claim 0xToken…`.

replaces.description: Ids of OPEN cards this one supersedes (they are closed as replaced) — e.g. a re-split payout to the same address.

then.description: What you will do once the owner has decided every card you raised in this conversation. You are woken with each card's outcome; this text is shown back to you then.

why.description: One line: why you propose it.
